title: TSBugs Explorer: Exploring and Benchmarking TypeScript Bugs
abstract: arXiv:2611.14940v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Curated datasets of real-world software bugs support empirical research in software testing, debugging, and automated program repair. However, exploring heterogeneous bug collections, comparing fault characteristics across projects, and constructing research-specific subsets often require manual inspection and custom scripts. We present TSBugs Explorer, an interactive visual analytics platform built upon our previously-published dataset of 633 bugs from 16 open-source TypeScript repositories, classified into 11 fault categories. The platform integrates bug records, repository characteristics, dependency information, and taxonomy guidance through coordinated visualizations, interactive filtering, and detailed bug inspection. It supports alternative aggregation and normalization of fault distributions, pairwise repository comparisons, and analysis of differences in observed fault profiles. translated_title: TSBugs Explorer：TypeScript缺陷的探索与基准测试平台
translated_abstract: 精选的真实世界软件缺陷数据集为软件测试、调试和自动化程序修复等领域的实证研究提供了支持。然而，探索异构的缺陷集合、比较不同项目间的故障特征以及构建面向特定研究的子集，往往需要人工检查和自定义脚本。我们提出了TSBugs Explorer，这是一个交互式可视化分析平台，构建于我们先前发表的、包含来自16个开源TypeScript仓库的633个缺陷并划分为11个故障类别的数据集之上。该平台通过协同联动的可视化、交互式过滤和详细的缺陷检查，整合了缺陷记录、仓库特征、依赖信息以及分类体系指导。它支持故障分布的多种聚合与归一化方式、成对的仓库比较，以及对所观察到的故障特征差异的分析。集成的基准构建器允许研究者（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了TSBugs Explorer，一个基于633个真实TypeScript缺陷数据集构建的交互式可视化分析平台，支持缺陷探索、跨仓库故障特征比较以及面向研究的基准子集构建。
en_tdlr: This paper presents TSBugs Explorer, an interactive visual analytics platform built upon a dataset of 633 real-world TypeScript bugs, enabling bug exploration, cross-repository fault characteristic comparison, and construction of research-specific benchmark subsets.
